explanation: Faithfully states the lower bound f(n) ≥ (1 - o(1))√(n/log n), which follows from the Hefty–Horn–King–Pfender construction as quoted on erdosproblems.com/1104. f(n) is the maximum chromatic number of a triangle-free graph on Fin n. The sSup is over a nonempty set bounded by n, so it is a genuine maximum.
